newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada grain body sees 96/97 flax output 859,200 T.
newsitem.headline: Canada grain body sees 96/97 flax output 859,200 T.

text.p: The Canadian Grain Commission on Monday estimated flaxseed output at 859,200 tonnes in crop year 1996/97 (Aug/July) down 22 percent from last year's production of 1.10 million tonnes.
The decline was attributed to a 30 percent decrease in seeded area to 615,100 hectares.

"The Statistics Canada production estimate was based on an average yield of 1400 kg/ha (22.3 bu/ac). Industry reports of 25-30 bu/ac yields are common but significant flax is still not harvested and won't be until spring," the CGC said.
Saskatchewan harvested 76 percent of its flax by Nov 4.
Manitoba combined 94 percent of its flax by Nov 4, according to the Canadian Wheat Board's weather and crop surveillance department.
